headline: TC Energy Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates, Rise Y/Y
summary: TRP expects comparable EBITDA at the upper end of its C$11.6-C$11.8 billion guidance and net capital expenditures of C$5.5-C$6 billion.

headline: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for Halliburton Stock?
summary: Halliburton has rallied better than the broader market over the past year, and analysts are fairly bullish about its future growth projections.
